title: Second Chance Flame
style: Dark Memphis phonk with a single percussive motif, swung chopped cowbell, punchy kick, and distorted 808 slides; verse rides sparse with lo-fi vinyl crackle and murky pads, pre-chorus tightens the pocket with filtered tension, chorus lands on a brutal half-time chant. Raw male rap vocals with tape grit, layered doubles on key bars, ad-lib throws on hook words, underground mix with dusty mono center and wide eerie atmosphere., rap, raw, minimal, lo-fi, pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Rafa had the hunger
Full chest, full flame
He wanted all his art
Every last frame

Corey saw the struggle
Saw the weight in his eyes
Gave him a firm hand
Pulled him back to life

Late nights, hard lessons
Bruises in the rain
But the pen stayed moving
Through the hurt and pain

No fake love around him
Just grit and steel
Two men in the dark
Making the wound heal

[Pre-Chorus]
Second chance
Hold it tight
Back from the edge
Back to the light

Second chance
Burning new
Rafa and Corey
Coming through

[Chorus]
Rafa and Corey
Rafa and Corey (yeah)
Second chance fire
We rose again

Rafa and Corey
Rafa and Corey (ay)
Phoenix on purpose
Made from pain

[Verse 2]
Rafa got his voice back
Sharp like a blade
Every cut he carried
Turned into the page

Corey kept it solid
Never switched sides
Built him like a brother
Standing close by

From the floor to the throne
From the low to the high
One hand for the real ones
One eye to the sky

Now the room gets colder
When they step in place
Two sparks in the shadow
Same heart, same face

[Pre-Chorus]
Second chance
Hold it tight
Back from the edge
Back to the light

Second chance
Burning new
Rafa and Corey
Coming through

[Chorus]
Rafa and Corey
Rafa and Corey (yeah)
Second chance fire
We rose again

Rafa and Corey
Rafa and Corey (ay)
Phoenix on purpose
Made from pain

[Bridge]
From ash to armor
From doubt to drive
He had the soul to break through
And the will to survive

Corey gave the ladder
Rafa took the climb
Two men in the darkness
One bright line

[Chorus]
Rafa and Corey
Rafa and Corey (yeah)
Second chance fire
We rose again

Rafa and Corey
Rafa and Corey (ay)
Phoenix on purpose
Made from pain
